Codex review: needs maintainer review before merge. ## What this changes This PR batches displayed streaming text and prevents token-only updates and unchanged history from rebuilding the native chat transcript. **Example:** A native chat displays 60 history rows while receiving 128 assistant text events. - **Before:** Each text update can invalidate the enclosing transcript and issue another scroll command. - **After:** Growing text updates in short batches inside the live bubble, while readers can remain on rows 48–51 through completion. ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🦞 diamond lobster **(5/6)** | Focused owner-level repair with inspected native app evidence, meaningful observation regressions, and no open correctness or security finding. | | **Proof confidence** | 🦞 diamond lobster **(5/6)** | Sufficient (logs): The iPhone 17 simulator app exercises the production chat view and view model with a 60-row transcript, streamed text, token-only events, unchanged history, and completion; inspected screenshots and runtime logs demonstrate paced rendering and preserved reading position, and the relevant mechanisms remain unchanged from the tested revision. | | **Patch quality** | 🦞 diamond lobster **(5/6)** | No actionable review findings were identified. | ## Product **Kind:** Performance · **Worth it:** Yes · **Fix scope:** Complete **User problem:** Native chat performs avoidable transcript work while replies stream, token counters advance, or unchanged history arrives. **Reason:** The source-supported defect has clear responsiveness value, and the repair stays within the shared native presentation owner without adding settings or persistent state. ## Merge readiness ✅ **Ready for maintainer review** Keep this PR open: it addresses a remaining native chat performance defect, resolves the earlier findings, and introduces no actionable bug found in this review. **Priority:** P2 **Reviewed head:** `14452ca3b2b75724682e8c6dd3fc593df46142fc` ## Before merge None. ## Findings None.

Current main exposes both reported observation paths, and supplied regressions cover token-only updates and identical history; this read-only review did not execute target code. Is this the best way to solve the issue? The change repairs the existing shared observation owner, isolates frequent display updates, and preserves sequence ordering, duplicate suppression, narration settlement, and terminal cleanup.
